services.name: Pre-Contract Risk Review
services.summary: Engineering-led technical and commercial review before signing Saudi-governed or FIDIC-based project contracts.
best_for: Foreign EPC contractors before tender finalization or contract signature
Developers and investment committees assessing allocation of project risk
Boards seeking an independent view before accepting Saudi project exposure
typical_inputs: Scope, technical appendices, and risk allocation clauses
Programme, payment, variation, notice, and claim procedures
typical_outputs: Risk register and executive risk briefing
services.legal_boundary: Advisory analysis only; not legal advice or counsel.

services.name: Project Risk Oversight
services.summary: Retained review of live project correspondence, notice discipline, variation posture, and delay exposure.
best_for: Live Saudi construction and infrastructure projects
Project teams facing accumulating correspondence, delay, variation, or evidence issues
typical_outputs: Escalation-ready technical and commercial briefing points
services.legal_boundary: Advisory analysis only; not site supervision, legal representation, or claims filing.

services.name: Pre-Litigation Technical Advisory
services.summary: Engineering-led chronology, evidence, causation, and claim-viability support before formal dispute proceedings.
best_for: Dispute-adjacent matters before legal positions harden
Law firms requiring technical counterpart support
Contractors or developers preparing evidence and chronology
typical_inputs: Programme, delay, variation, and payment records
Technical reports, site records, and decision logs
services.legal_boundary: Not arbitration counsel, litigation counsel, or sworn expert testimony.

services.name: Independent Technical Opinion
services.summary: Confidential second-opinion advisory for boards, law firms, headquarters, and investment committees evaluating Saudi project exposure.
best_for: Independent technical review before a strategic decision
typical_inputs: Relevant contract, correspondence, schedule, and technical evidence
services.legal_boundary: Advisory opinion only; not sworn expert testimony unless separately approved and verified.

services.name: Supply Chain and Vendor Risk Assessment
services.summary: Independent review of subcontractor, vendor, and supply-chain capability, risk exposure, and execution readiness.
best_for: Projects with critical subcontractor or vendor dependency
Pre-award or recovery-stage supply chain decisions
Boards or project teams concerned about execution capability
typical_inputs: Delivery history, programme dependencies, and performance records
services.legal_boundary: Commercial and technical advisory only; not procurement brokerage or vendor endorsement.

services.name: Board Risk Briefing
services.summary: Concise executive briefing for boards, investment committees, and headquarters facing Saudi project risk decisions.
best_for: Sensitive matters requiring discreet technical and commercial framing
typical_inputs: Material contracts, correspondence, and technical records
services.legal_boundary: Executive advisory only; not legal advice or investment advice.
